FORM 10-Q — QUARTERLY REPORT

PART I — FINANCIAL INFORMATION

Item 1. Financial Statements

The accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with GAAP for interim financial reporting.

Item 2. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Net sales for the quarter rose compared with the prior-year period, reflecting higher unit volumes and a favorable product mix. Operating expenses grew more slowly than revenue, expanding operating margin. We continue to monitor input costs and foreign-exchange movements that may affect upcoming quarters. Management expects seasonal demand to support results in the second half, subject to ordinary competitive pressures and the broader economic environment described elsewhere in this report.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes to our market-risk exposures since the most recent annual report.

Item 4. Controls and Procedures

Our disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of the end of the period.
